doc.class_javadoc:
/** * Scope contains information about a variable scope in javascript. * Scopes can be nested, a scope points back to its parent scope. * A Scope contains information about variables defined in that scope. *

* A Scope is also used as a lattice element for flow-sensitive type inference. * As a lattice element, a Scope is viewed as a map from names to types. A name * not in the map is considered to have the bottom type. The join of two maps m1 * and m2 is the map of the union of names with {@link JSType#getLeastSupertype} * to meet the m1 type and m2 type. * * @see NodeTraversal * @see DataFlowAnalysis * */ public
